description: Random Forest trained on the FUSED feature set: Member 1's 2,048 Morgan bits + 5 scaled RDKit descriptors concatenated with Member 2's 128 learned DL embeddings. Also supports probability blending with Member 2's DL model.

raw_features.contents: 2,048 binary Morgan bits + 5 scaled RDKit descriptors
raw_features.note: Descriptors standardised in Phase 1 using training statistics only.

random_forest.note: Deeper and wider than the Phase 1 forest to exploit the 2,181 fused features.

ensemble.alpha_grid_note: The requested [0.5 .. 0.7] grid was extended because validation macro ROC-AUC was still rising at alpha=0.70.

feature_arm_selection.finding: Concatenating the 128 dense embeddings onto the 2,053 raw features LOWERS validation macro ROC-AUC from 0.8044 to 0.7800. Random Forests pick splits by impurity gain over sqrt(n_features) sampled columns, and a continuous embedding offers thousands of candidate thresholds where a binary Morgan bit offers one, so the 128 embeddings win far more splits than their 6% share of columns warrants and crowd out the fingerprint evidence. max_features retuning does not rescue it (see reports/fusion_study_features.csv). The learned representation is therefore combined at the PROBABILITY level instead of the input level.
